About the release

2026 Topps Chrome® Football returns to establish Chrome® as the premier annual release for NFL collectors.

The product pairs industry-defining Chrome® Rookie Cards of the 2026 Draft Class with a deep lineup of active stars and NFL legends. Chase Rookie Cards of Fernando Mendoza, Jeremiyah Love, Carnell Tate, Jordyn Tyson, and Caleb Downs alongside stars including Josh Allen, CeeDee Lamb, Jahymr Gibbs, and Myles Garrett.

Signature Short Prints bring even more personality to the product. Returning Chrome® favorites Helix, Ultra Violet, and Chrome® Radiating Rookies join football-specific chases including Game Genies, Kaiju, and Tecmo, plus new addition Glass Canvas, Madden 99 Club, and Super Bowl at Night.

Premium autograph content spans rookies, veterans, and legends, delivering must-have signatures from some of the game’s biggest names, highlighted by NFL Honors Gold Shield Autographs and even more high-impact chases throughout Chrome® Football.

About the brand

Topps Chrome® is one of the most iconic trading card brands in the hobby. Renowned for its vibrant refractors, expansive rainbow chases, and premium autograph content, Topps Chrome® has helped define modern collecting across sports and entertainment.

facts.publishedText:
Don’t miss the next release
Topps® Museum UEFA Club Competitions 2025/26
Get notified
Download checklist
Download odds
About the release

Topps is pleased to announce the new Topps Museum Collection UEFA Club Competitions 2025/26! The collection captures the biggest stars across UEFA Club Competitions with a mix of seasoned veterans, young stars on the rise, and legends of the pitch. Inside each Hobby Box you will find 1 Sequentially Numbered Base Card Parallel, 1 Autograph Card, 1 Relic Card, and 1 Autograph-Relic Card. One pack per box. Eight cards per pack.

Collect all 100 Base Cards including a multitude of the biggest European clubs, and search for the brand-new insert Museum Roll of Honor recognizing some of football’s biggest names etched in history. Additionally continue your hunt to complete The Grail!

Search for stunning autographs in Archival Autographs, Museum Rookie Autographs, Museum Framed Autographs, and Showpiece Signatures. Pairings from both the past and present can be found on Archival Dual Autographs. Breathtaking on-card autographs can be found on Legendary Ink Framed Autographs and the elusive Marks of Excellence.

Relics from the biggest stars in football can be collected from Meaningful Material Single Relics, Momentous Material Jumbo Relics, Single Player Triple Relics, Museum Rookie Relics, and Single Player Swatches Dual Relics. Feel closer to the beautiful game with Legacy Boot Relic Cards, UEFA Foundation Patch Cards, Home/Away Dual Relic Cards, and the brand-new Curated Collars Relic Cards. Put together iconic names by collecting all of a player’s Museum Nameplate Relic Cards, a first-time subset for Topps Museum Collection UEFA Club Competitions.

A beautiful slew of autograph-relic cards can be found in Museum Autograph Relics, Museum Framed Autographed Patch Cards, and Museum Rookie Autograph Relics. Also, hunt for the rare Legacy Laces Autograph Relics and the brand-new Curated Collars Autograph Relic Cards.

Search for the unique, museum-worthy book cards such as Supreme Script Legendary Autographed Relic Book Cards, and Kit Construction Triple Relic Autograph Book Cards. Both possess qualities of true masterpieces.

What are you chasing?
Museum Roll of Honor

Search for the brand-new insert Museum Roll of Honor recognizing some of football’s biggest names etched in history

Autograph Cards

Search for stunning autographs in Archival Autographs, Museum Rookie Autographs, Museum Framed Autographs, and Showpiece Signatures.

Relic Cards

Feel closer to the beautiful game with Legacy Boot Relic Cards, UEFA Foundation Path Cards, Home/Away Dual Relic Cards, Curated Collars Relic Cards, and Museum Nameplate Relic Cards.

About the brand

Rooted in a brand legacy that spans multiple sports, Topps Museum Collection UCC 2025/26 brings a hit-driven experience of the UEFA Club Competitions, combining elite autographs, rare memorabilia, and legendary names from world football. Since its UCC debut in the 2017/18 season, Topps Museum Collection has stood as a cornerstone for autograph and relic soccer cards - designed for collectors who demand craftsmanship and unforgettable chase moments.

Although the history of Topps Museum Collection UCC began in 2017/18, the Topps Museum Collection brand itself was originally launched several years earlier with baseball in 2012. The idea behind the brand reflects the Topps philosophy of delivering the best possible collecting experience and bringing fans closer to the stars they admire. With the unique memorabilia featured in this collection, Museum does exactly that - giving collectors a rare connection to the athletes they follow.

facts.title: 2026 Topps Vault Disney | Official Topps Store
facts.publishedText:
Don't miss the next release
2026 Topps Vault Disney
Unlock the magic of Disney
Get notified
Download checklist
Download odds
About the release

2026 Topps Vault Disney unlocks an ultra-premium collecting experience through a high-end two-card format inspired by the exclusivity and security of an actual vault. Each box offers the chance to uncover on-card autographs, multi-signed cards, authentic production-used memorabilia, original sketches, and cards embedded with real diamonds. 

Disney’s cinematic history comes to life through relics sourced from memorable set pieces, including props from Alice in Wonderland, Jungle Cruise, Snow White, Haunted Mansion, and more. Then, autograph content features standout talent such as Johnny Depp, Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, Kristen Bell, Keira Knightley, Orlando Bloom, and others, with select cards pairing signatures directly with production-used material. Also, look for first-time Disney autographs from Anne Hathaway, Chris Pratt, Willem Dafoe, Ian McKellan, Geoffrey Rush, Tessa Thompson, Cate Blanchett, and others! 

Collectors can also discover breathtaking sketches, original artwork, nostalgic autograph book cards, and more! This celebration of artistry extends to box toppers featuring original work by Julie Vu, available in a range of parallels. Select boxes may even contain an oversized sketch card instead!

Combining beloved characters, marquee talent, extraordinary memorabilia, and luxury finishes, 2026 Topps Vault Disney delivers a premium experience built around the magic of uncovering something truly exceptional.

What to look for?
Immortal Autographs

Immortal Autographs celebrates legendary Disney performances with a powerful lineup of on-card signatures. Collect autographs from Will Smith, Kristen Bell, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe, Ian McKellan, and more, showcased in a striking design worthy of the insert’s enduring name.

Learn more
Vault Autograph Relic Duals

Vault Autograph Relic Duals brings two Disney stars together on a single card, pairing their signatures with authentic production-used memorabilia. Look for standout combinations including Anne Hathaway and Johnny Depp, and more!

Learn more
Vault Autograph Relics

Vault Autograph Relics pairs signatures from some of Disney’s biggest stars with authentic production-used memorabilia. Look for standout cards featuring Anne Hathaway, Johnny Depp, Tessa Thompson, Jude Law, Owen Wilson, and more, each paired with a prop or set piece used in a Disney production.

Learn more
Disney Triples

Disney Triples delivers blockbuster star power with three signatures featured together on a single card. Collect star-studded trios featuring Johnny Depp, Orlando Bloom, and Keira Knightley; Halle Bailey, Daveed Diggs, and Melissa McCarthy; and more!

Learn more
Retro Blockbusters

Retro Blockbusters rewinds to the golden age of Disney home video with autograph book cards inspired by the colorful VHS covers that filled shelves throughout the 1990s. Capturing the nostalgia of a beloved era of Disney entertainment, the insert features signatures from Jodi Benson, Paige O’Hara, Matthew Broderick, Whoopi Goldberg, and more!

Learn more
Vault Relics

Vault Relics connects collectors directly to Disney films through cards featuring authentic production-used memorabilia. The insert includes material from the teapot in Alice in Wonderland, fragments of Trader Sam’s throne in Jungle Cruise, and more!

Learn more
Vault Originals

Collect oversized box toppers showcasing original artwork by Julie Vu.

Magic Montage

Magic Montage showcases original artwork by Tim Rogerson, bringing iconic Disney characters to life as dynamic color silhouettes within a larger montage. Each framed card pairs the artwork with an autograph from the talent who voiced or portrayed the featured character, creating a vibrant fusion of art and Disney storytelling. Find autographs from Josh Gad, Bret Iwan, and more!

Learn more
Who is EQL?

EQL is a third-party commerce platform that helps manage the launch of exclusive products. Topps has now partnered with EQL to help manage new launches of unique and limited-edition Topps products. EQL helps us slow down bots and to deliver a launch that is fair.

Partnering with EQL means that:

Every entry goes through a multi-step security verification process that confirms you are a human, slowing down bots from submitting orders.

One entry per person because entries are deduplicated against unique identification tags.

It should be simple to enter – once you have a verified EQL account, entering becomes a breeze.

PLEASE READ THE FOLLOWING TERMS AND CONDITIONS AND PRIVACY POLICIES BEFORE ATTEMPTING TO PARTICIPATE IN AN EQL RELEASE:

* EQL’s Terms and Conditions and EQL’s Privacy Policy which govern your use of the EQL platform.* Topps.com’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Notice which govern your use of Topps.com and your entry should your entry be selected by EQL.
Learn more about the EQL draw here.
About the brand

Topps Vault is a high-end entertainment brand designed to showcase the coveted talent, materials, and moments from the world’s most celebrated properties. Each release offers a carefully curated experience shaped around its featured franchise, with rare autographs, authentic memorabilia, original sketches, and luxury card constructions. For fans, it is a chance elevate their collections and own standout pieces that bring them closer to the stories they love.

About the release

2026 Topps Holiday Football brings the magic of the season to the field, pairing festive creativity with the excitement of a new NFL season. The release showcases the highly anticipated 2026 rookie class alongside fan-favorite veterans, giving Collectors the opportunity to chase the players defining today’s game through a distinctly holiday-inspired lens.

Throughout the product, Collectors can discover unique holiday-inspired parallels, variations, and subsets that bring an unexpected seasonal spin to football collecting. New additions like Rookies Holiday Spirit Variation put a festive spotlight on the league’s newest stars, while Snow Globe Moments celebrates memorable players and moments through an all-new winter-inspired design. From established stars to the next generation of talent, 2026 Topps Holiday Football delivers a playful collecting experience unlike anything else in the Topps portfolio.

Whether you’re chasing your favorite rookie, collecting your team, or looking for something completely different to rip this holiday season, 2026 Topps Holiday Football brings together the excitement of football and the spirit of the holidays in every pack.

What to look for
Base Holiday Spirit Variation

Base Holiday Spirit Variations deck out the base set with festive designs and seasonal imagery featuring top NFL stars.

Dear Santa

Dear Santa is an autograph relic subset that reimagines the traditional card as a playful holiday letter, featuring a Santa-inspired autograph area where players sign their “wish list” for the season.

Hidden Elf

Random Elfs located around the player, flushed into the base design.

Rookie Holiday Spirit Variation

Short print of top rookies, with a unique variety of flannel holiday design.

About the brand

Topps Holiday brings a seasonal twist to the collecting experience, combining the excitement of the sport with festive, holiday-inspired designs. The product offers collectors a fun and approachable way to engage with their favorite athletes while incorporating unique seasonal elements throughout the set. With a mix of familiar names, standout players, and holiday-themed details, Topps Holiday provides an engaging collecting experience that can appeal to both longtime collectors and fans looking to celebrate the season.

It’s more than a set. It’s a celebration. Whether you’re ripping packs by the fireplace or gifting the joy of collecting, Topps Holiday makes every pull feel magical.

About the release

Celebrate 75 years of Topps Baseball with 2026 Update Series.

2026 Update Series rounds out the year-long celebration of the 75th Anniversary of Topps Baseball, honoring the most iconic name in trading cards. For 75 years, Topps Baseball has defined The Hobby by capturing the game’s greatest players and moments, generation after generation.

Celebrate the legacy of Topps Baseball with anniversary-themed inserts and parallels that honor the brand’s rich history, including Cover Athletes, 75 Years of Topps Die-Cut Autographs, and 75 Years of Topps Baseball Autographs.

Update Series delivers a 350-card Base Set featuring today’s biggest MLB stars, top rookies, and Future Stars. As the final Flagship release of the year, the checklist captures in-season call-ups, players in new uniforms following trades, and memorable moments from across the season. Fan-favorite designs such as All Aces, Heavy Lumber, and Home Field return, while additions introduced throughout Series 1 and Series 2 – including Base Card 1952 Variations and 1991 Topps Baseball – continue in Update Series.

Autographs and relics remain a cornerstone of the Topps Baseball experience, highlighted by Real One Autographs, Flagship Autograph Patch Cards, City Connect Swatches, and one-of-one In the Name relics.

What to look for
Home Field

Player paired with iconic imagery from their home ballparks.

Base Card Rookie 1952 Variation

Top rookies presented on the iconic 1952 Topps design, with imagery styled to match the original set. Beginning in 2026, Topps Baseball (Series 1, Series 2, and Update Series) will serve as the exclusive home of the 1952 design.

Heavy Lumber

Wood-grained cards highlighting the league’s best batsmen, with autograph variations.

About the brand

Since 1952, Topps Baseball has defined trading card collecting for generations. Each year’s design sets the visual standard for Topps Baseball products and influences other Topps releases. A staple of The Hobby for 75 years, it offers a wide range of designs, inserts, autograph patch cards, and relics. Known for iconic rookie cards and memorable sets, Topps Baseball remains one of the most anticipated releases each season, appealing to collectors of all styles.
